verdict.rationale: The evidence documents only POS UI extensions, which add tiles, modals and blocks inside Shopify's own POS app. Those extensions can call the GraphQL Admin API, but that is an in-app building block, not a documented server-driven API that lets a backend drive a payment terminal for a custom checkout. No evidence shows a terminal-control or server-driven payments API.

support.subject: As a developer, I can build a custom point-of-sale checkout that drives the terminal from my backend through a documented server-driven API

citations.quote: With Shopify POS UI extensions, you can add custom functionality directly into Shopify's point-of-sale interface.
Extensions can also query the GraphQL Admin API directly using standard fetch() calls.
